name: Afflictions & Blessings
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Afflictions & Blessings
Track the impossible conditions characters contract, inherit, or earn. Use this EXACT format:

[AFFLICT|Character|Condition|Course]
note: MANDATORY; cause, folk remedy attempted, or prognosis
[/AFFLICT]

Condition examples: haunted by a specific Wednesday | speaks in borrowed voices after dusk | casts two shadows, one punctual | three inches taller when lying | followed by rain sized for one
Course options: 🌱 ONSET | 🌾 CHRONIC | 🌗 WANING | 🍂 CURED AT A COST | 🌸 KEPT ON PURPOSE

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where a condition is gained, worsens, eases, or is embraced.
- Tie each condition to the character's emotional state, so the symptom expresses what they feel.
- Charge a specific price for every cure and state that price in the note.
- Treat KEPT ON PURPOSE as a full outcome: a character may keep a condition because it has become part of who they are.

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with note: and keep the whole note on that single line; put the closing [/AFFLICT] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
